headline: Elon Musk's $446 Million Midterms Spending Yields Poor Returns in US Elections
summary: Elon Musk poured a record $446 million into Super PACs supporting failed Republican candidates during the US midterm elections, marking a costly political outcome.
why: Elon Musk is the CEO of major publicly traded and private firms including Tesla and SpaceX; significant political spending highlights corporate leadership focus.
